description: This file defines 'ContentInfoActivity', an Android activity responsible for displaying detailed program content information in an Android TV application. It manages UI elements such as program metadata, focusable action buttons, system date/time, and user interactions via D-PAD navigation and button presses. It includes intent creation for launching the activity with specific content parameters.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed content information including program metadata, action buttons, system date/time, and handles user interaction via focus and key events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, populates content data, and configures action buttons.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Displays the current system date and time in specified formats.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Retrieves intent extras or defaults and populates UI elements with program metadata.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons with icons, labels, focus and click handlers.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates focus transitions on action buttons for visual feedback.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Handles actions triggered by button presses, including visual feedback and placeholder logic for specific functionalities.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for D-PAD navigation, selection, and back button.
